visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Nana, a young woman with her hair in buns, wears a black leather jacket and a small pink crossbody bag. She stands in a brightly lit retail store, holding a large pink "Mega Space Molly" box featuring various Sanrio characters. She smiles and points at the character illustrations. (2) A male store assistant in a black hoodie enters the frame and points at the characters on the box while Nana holds a coffee cup. They are surrounded by shelves of toys and character posters in a clean, modern store environment with warm lighting. (3) Nana starts to open the large box, her facial expressions showing intense anticipation and nervousness. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen. She carefully peels back the cardboard flaps and peers inside the box with wide eyes. (4) She triumphantly pulls out a large Kuromi-themed Molly figure encased in a transparent plastic shell. She jumps with joy and dances slightly, her face filled with excitement. The assistant stands nearby, smiling and gesturing towards her success. (5) Close-up shots highlight the details of the purple and white space-themed Kuromi figure, including its helmet and accessories. Nana is shown posing with the figure and adjusting its parts. Vibrant variety-style text overlays appear to emphasize the festive mood.
